# Just the Route

> A growing archive of Philadelphia running routes and race-day videos.
> Real routes. Real time. Know the turns before you run them.

Just the Route is a route-first running video archive made by Bill Curtin, a runner, therapist, husband, and dad from Philadelphia. Runs unfold in real time with natural sound and minimal editing, plus a GPS route overlay. Every route page includes route notes, an interactive map, and a downloadable GPX file.

## The archive (as of October 2026)
- Spring Garden Bridge (0.55 mi) — Mantua Avenue / Powelton Village across the Spring Garden Bridge to the Philadelphia Museum of Art
- Schuylkill River Loop, counterclockwise (~8.4 mi) — Art Museum, up Kelly Drive, across Falls Bridge, back down MLK Drive
- Schuylkill River Loop, clockwise (~8.5 mi) — up MLK Drive, across Falls Bridge, back down Kelly Drive
- Schuylkill Banks — river run along the Schuylkill Banks
- MLK Drive — Falls Bridge to Spring Garden Bridge along the Schuylkill River
- Forbidden Run Fest 21K — full 13.1-mile Wissahickon Valley Park course, unofficial course tour
- Wissahickon Trail Nor'Easter — four rainy miles along Forbidden Drive
- Philadelphia Distance Run 2026 — race-day footage, start to approximately mile 11

Coming soon: full Philadelphia Marathon 2026 course preview (filmed October 2026).
